title: Could SpaceX & other mega IPOs crowd out the stock market?
title_zh: SpaceX 和其他大型 IPO 能否挤出股市？
summary: Deutsche Bank chief global strategist Binky Chadha joins Yahoo Finance to explain how mega initial public offerings (IPOs) from Anthropic (ANTH.PVT), SpaceX (SPAX.PVT), and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) could affect the broader markets (^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC).

title: Markets watch Iran ceasefire talks as investors assess mega IPO valuations: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq, Wall Street Futures
title_zh: 随着投资者评估大型 IPO 估值，市场关注伊朗停火谈判：道琼斯、标准普尔、纳斯达克、华尔街期货
summary: U. S. equity futures traded in a narrow range on Friday as investors monitored reports suggesting progress in negotiations aimed at extending the ceasefire between the United States and Iran.
summary_zh: 周五美国股指期货窄幅波动，因投资者关注有关旨在延长美国和伊朗停火协议的谈判取得进展的报告。

title: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square to Raise $5 Billion from IPO
title_zh: 比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 的潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 将通过 IPO 筹集 50 亿美元
summary: Closely followed investor Bill Ackman looks likely to raise $5 billion from the upcoming initial public offering (IPO) of his investment ​management company Pershing Square.
summary_zh: 备受关注的投资者比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 看来可能会通过其投资管理公司潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 即将进行的首次公开募股 (IPO) 筹集 50 亿美元。

title: SpaceX IPO Set to Be a Catalyst for 2026 IPO Boom: ETFs to Gain
title_zh: SpaceX IPO 将成为 2026 年 IPO 热潮的催化剂：ETF 将获利
summary: SpaceX could be the catalyst for a surge as the U.S. IPO market eyes a comeback. ETFs like FPX, IPO and IPOS offer an easy way to gain exposure.
summary_zh: 随着美国 IPO 市场有望卷土重来，SpaceX 可能成为股价飙升的催化剂。 FPX、IPO 和 IPOS 等 ETF 提供了一种获得投资的简单方法。
